  • Base sólida em contabilidade, análise financeira e leitura crítica de documentos contábeis, fiscais e societários;

Diferenciais

Senior OutSystems Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large‑scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands‑on, high‑impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom‑built solution.

What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

  • Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies
  • Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability
  • Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

  • Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies
  • Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database
  • Replace inefficient polling with event‑driven or conditional patterns
  • Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

  • Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues
  • Refactor exception handling and client‑side lifecycle violations
  • Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

  • Establish a true multi‑environment deployment pipeline
  • Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs
  • Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls
  • Ensure non‑production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

  • Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities
  • Remove unused or redundant components
  • Define governance for capacity‑impacting changes
  • Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

  • Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes
  • Map data entities into portable schemas
  • Capture business logic embedded within the platform
  • Identify core business logic vs platform‑generated components
  • Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building and maintaining enterprise‑scale OutSystems applications
  • Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API
  • Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements
  • Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures
  • Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing
  • Hands‑on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems
  • Strong problem‑solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations
  • Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows
  • Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling
  • Experience with license optimization and application object management
  • Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e‑signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership
  • Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions
  • Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations
  • Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users

This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high‑visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next‑generation platform.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Auxlilar de Professor - Fundamental 1 - Salvador/BA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 126 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 28 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares – Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!

Neste papel você irá cuidar das crianças, dos espaços e materiais, e também auxiliar o(a) professor(a) em suas atribuições e rotina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoiar o(a) Professor(a) Regente na condução das atividades de sala de aula, garantindo a participação ativa e o bem-estar das crianças;
  • Auxiliar no planejamento e preparo de materiais pedagógicos e lúdicos;
  • Estimular o uso do inglês no dia a dia, de forma natural e interativa, favorecendo a imersão linguística;
  • Acolher e acompanhar a rotina das crianças;
  • Manter a organização do ambiente escolar e dos recursos didáticos;
  • Orientar as crianças a manterem uma relação respeitosa e colaborativa entre elas;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Salvaguardar nossas crianças e jovens.

REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em andamento ou completa em Pedagogia;
  • Boa compreensão do ambiente escolar;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Nossos auxiliares de professor devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de apoio ao ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 1.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

A posição é voltada a profissionais que já tenham atuação relevante em investigações, disputas, auditoria investigativa, forensic accounting, compliance ou due diligence, e que tenham interesse em desenvolver uma atuação multidisciplinar, combinando análise financeira, direito, tecnologia forense, eDiscovery, inteligência corporativa e organização de evidências.

O profissional atuará em projetos relacionados a investigações internas, disputas societárias, levantamento e rastreamento de ativos, due diligence, análise de fluxos financeiros, apoio técnico a litígios e revisão de informações contábeis, fiscais, societárias e patrimoniais.

Principais atividades

  • Análise de demonstrações financeiras, balancetes, extratos bancários, documentos fiscais, registros societários e demais fontes documentais relevantes;
  • Mapeamento de fluxos financeiros, relações societárias, movimentações patrimoniais e estruturas de investimento;
  • Identificação de inconsistências, padrões atípicos, indícios de desvios, conflitos de interesse ou fragilidades documentais;
  • Apoio técnico em investigações internas, disputas societárias, processos de due diligence e projetos de inteligência patrimonial;
  • Organização, classificação e análise de evidências em ambientes estruturados de revisão documental e eDiscovery;
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos, memorandos de achados, cronologias, mapas de relacionamento e materiais de suporte a advogados, clientes e stakeholders;
  • Interação com equipes jurídicas, de tecnologia forense, compliance, auditoria, consultores externos e clientes.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Contabilidade, Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em investigações corporativas, forensic accounting, auditoria investigativa, compliance, disputas ou due diligence;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em consultorias, escritórios ou prestadores de serviços especializados, com atuação direta em projetos para clientes;
  • Base sólida em contabilidade, análise financeira e leitura crítica de documentos contábeis, fiscais e societários;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, redação técnica, raciocínio analítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Perfil investigativo, postura colaborativa e interesse em atuação multidisciplinar;
  • Inglês mandatório , com capacidade de leitura, escrita e participação em interações profissionais;

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento do mercado de capitais, fundos de investimento, estruturas societárias e instrumentos financeiros;
  • Experiência em auditoria, investigações de fraude, disputas societárias ou avaliação de danos;
  • Noções de análise de dados, tecnologia forense, eDiscovery ou ferramentas de revisão documental;
  • Familiaridade com temas regulatórios, compliance, governança corporativa e processos judiciais.

Essa plataforma reúne dados climáticos, ambientais e de saúde, com o objetivo de investigar os efeitos das mudanças climáticas na saúde da população em contextos de vulnerabilidade social, além de analisar como políticas ambientais e de proteção social podem reduzir esses efeitos.

O(a) candidato(a) irá integrar a equipe de pesquisadores principais do projeto “Plataforma Climática e Ambiental do CIDACS (CIDACS-Clima): dados para estudar o clima e a saúde”, desenvolvido pelo Centro de Integração de Dados e Conhecimentos para a Saúde (CIDACS/IGM/FIOCRUZ-BA), no Parque Tecnológico da Bahia (Salvador, BA, Brasil), em parceria com a London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM).

O(a) candidato(a) será responsável por auxiliar na construção de dashboards que integrem mapas a gráficos analíticos e séries temporais associadas.

Procuramos candidatos(as) altamente motivados(as), criativos(as) e com habilidades para se comunicar em um ambiente multidisciplinar.

Encorajamos fortemente candidaturas de pesquisadores(as) negros(as), LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos menos representados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Construir dashboards que integrem mapas a gráficos analíticos e séries temporais associadas;
  • Desenvolver componentes de visualização para mapas interativos, incluindo controle de camadas, legendas dinâmicas e filtros (espaciais, temporais e temáticos);
  • Documentar componentes e fluxos principais para garantir a manutenibilidade do código;
  • Garantir a responsividade e a experiência do usuário (UX) em fluxos complexos de análise de dados;
  • Implementar mecanismos avançados de interação: zoom, seleção espacial, destaque de áreas e alternância de períodos/anos;
  • Otimizar a performance da interface para carregamento de grandes volumes de dados (tiles, simplificação de geometrias e cache);
  • Participar da definição da arquitetura de mapas, prototipagem e escolha de tecnologias geoespaciais;
  • Participar de reuniões com a equipe do projeto e gerais do CIDACS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Geografia ou áreas correlatas com foco tecnológico;
  • Boa compreensão técnica de dados espaciais em formatos raster e vetor;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de tiles como MapTiler e Google Earth Engine;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais com extensão espacial (PostGIS/PostgreSQL);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git/GitHub) e fluxos de deploy;
  • Experiência com o consumo de APIs geográficas e integração com bancos de dados espaciais;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento front‑end com foco em bibliotecas de mapas (Leaflet, OpenLayers, D3.js, Chart.js, Mapbox GL JS);
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica;
  • Noções de Linux e Bash para automação de tarefas;
  • Noções de processamento de dados espaciais (projeções, sistemas de coordenadas CRS, operações de buffer e interseção);
  • Proatividade, facilidade de comunicação em equipes multidisciplinares e interesse em inovação tecnológica.

O que gostaríamos que você soubesse também

  • Conhecimento em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados de saúde e demográficos (Bases do DATASUS, IBGE);
  • Experiência com servidores de mapas e geradores de tiles (ex: GeoServer, Tippecanoe, Martin ou MapProxy);
  • Experiência em projetos de pesquisa que envolvam análise geoespacial ou indicadores socioambientais;
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de performance em WebSIG (Vector Tiles, simplificação no lado do cliente);
  • Noções de ferramentas de desktop GIS (QGIS ou ArcGIS) para preparação de bases;
  • A ausência destes requisitos não impede a sua candidatura, porém serão diferenciais para critério de desempate.

Informações adicionais

O CIDACS é um Centro de Dados que busca entender, estudar e avaliar, através de Big Data, as condições de saúde da população brasileira para oferecer auxílio e suporte a gestores públicos, pesquisadores e à comunidade. As bolsas de pesquisa são pagas pela Fundação de Apoio à FIOCRUZ – FIOTEC.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hardware Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands‑on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end‑to‑end.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker‑based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Personally design a portfolio of high‑difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.

Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S‑parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP‑based design, real‑time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands‑on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands‑on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open‑source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.

Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus

Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience)

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus

About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.

Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.

We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more.

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands‑on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market.

Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions.
  • Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs.
  • Get hands‑on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues.
  • Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities.
  • Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster.
  • Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM.
  • Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer‑facing or FAE roles.
  • Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces.
  • Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis.
  • Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug.
  • Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Hands‑on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points For

  • Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type‑C.
  • Experience with high‑speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO.
  • RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi‑Fi 802.11.
  • Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration.
  • Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.

The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas.
  • Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies.
  • Founding‑team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000‑person publicly‑listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side‑by‑side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting‑edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer‑facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.
  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co‑pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LINES is a real‑time, community‑driven going‑out platform delivering live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on it every weekend. We are scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real‑time feeds, ticketing, and future features.


What you'll do



  • Design backend systems for real‑time, localized, event‑driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram‑style)

  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization

  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients

  • Own features end‑to‑end—architecture, implementation, deployment, observability

  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency

  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database

  • Design data models for high‑write, real‑time systems

  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction

  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows

  • Write short specs—problem, approach, tradeoffs—to move faster, not slower


What we expect



  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems‑first mindset

  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization

  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs

  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small

  • Hands‑on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it

  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar

  • Comfortable with high‑write, read‑heavy workloads and eventual consistency

  • Pragmatic—ships impact, not over‑engineering

  • Thrives in early‑stage chaos with shifting priorities

  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast

  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality


Tech stack



  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript

  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare

  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)

  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions


Nice to have



  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces

  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience

  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)

  • Real‑time systems (chat, live updates, video)

  • React Native or Expo

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Web Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.

If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated, brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.

Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.

API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).

Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.

Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Hands‑on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.

Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).

Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.

Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

Digital Marketing / Pay Per Click Assistant Overview

The Digital Marketing / Pay Per Click Assistant is responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. Account Audits & Diagnostics

Tracking, Data & Reporting

  • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking.

  • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities.
  • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps.

Process & Quality Control

  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation.

description:

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.


Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)
  • Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).

Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade.

  • Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes.

  • Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs).

  • Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Pessoa Executiva De Soluções De Negócios Sênior – Crédito B2b
description:

Buscamos uma pessoa Executiva de Soluções de Negócios Sênior para atuar de forma altamente consultiva em soluções financeiras B2B, com foco em crédito, pagamentos e produtos Techfin.   • Atuar em forte sinergia com áreas internas e parceiros estratégicos para otimizar a proposta de valor das soluções Techfin;
  • Identificar oportunidades de cross-selling e upselling, incluindo soluções de crédito consignado empresarial, pagamentos (Pix, boletos, etc.) e serviços complementares;
  • Gerenciar todo o pipeline comercial com autonomia, garantindo previsibilidade, acuracidade de forecast e atingimento das metas;
  • Mapear tendências de mercado para antecipar demandas e propor soluções personalizadas aos clientes;
  • Realizar análise financeira das operações, avaliando riscos, indicadores e estruturação de crédito;
  • Apoiar a experiência do cliente em todo o ciclo comercial, colaborando com times internos (Crédito, Produto, Comercial, TI, Marketing).


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Finanças ou correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente em meios de pagamento ou soluções financeiras;
  • Vivência em negociação com médias e grandes empresas e condução de reuniões estratégicas com decisores;
  • Conhecimento avançado em produtos de crédito PJ (análise de crédito, riscos, estruturação de operações);
  • Familiaridade com soluções complementares como crédito consignado empresarial e pagamentos (Pix, boletos, adquirência);
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para leitura de indicadores financeiros e de negócio;
  • Histórico consistente de superação de metas e gestão de carteira com visão de expansão;
  • Organização de pipeline e disciplina de forecast;
  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e postura consultiva.


SERÁ CONSIDERADO COMO UM DIFERENCIAL:

  • MBA ou Pós-Graduação voltado a área de Negócios;
  • Conhecimento doecossistema TOTVS / ERPs;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens;
  • CNH válida;
  • Desejável possuir veículo próprio.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Processos Pleno | Simões Filho, Ba em simões filho. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão

O(a) profissional será responsável por padronizar processos, impulsionar melhorias, desenvolver e realizar treinamentos, monitorar KPIs para

propor soluções e garantir suporte na implementação de novos processos. Terá também participação ativa na resolução ágil de problemas e será

referência técnica operacional.

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas

Excel intermediário à avançado.

Inglês intermediário a Avançado.

Experiência em mapeamento de processos, melhoria contínua (Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma) e padronização;

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

Capacidade analítica para gestão de indicadores e análise de dados;

Visão estratégicae foco em resultados;

Desejável experiência na área de logística;

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Inglês em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

fully remote position

Salary in $

many benefits

Your main tasks at the position will be to:

-Write simple automation scripts (Python) for bulk operations — e.G., mass API retries, data migrations, batch status checks

-Monitor service status proactively: identify and initiate resolution of incidents before customers report them

-Collaborate with development, DevOps, and product teams via Slack and Jira for escalations and knowledge sharing

-Contribute to the internal Knowledge Base to improve AI-assisted resolution and team efficiency

Requirements:

Required: experience working with the LATAM market.

AI & Automation

● Practical experience using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor or similar) as daily work tools — not just casual use, but integrated into troubleshooting and communication workflows

● Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to craft effective prompts for technical tasks

● Familiarity with AI integration concepts: MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI skills/contexts, connecting AI to internal systems (preferred, can be trained)

Observability & Monitoring

● Hands-on experience with Grafana and/or Datadog — specifically building dashboards, creating alerts, and working with data sources (not just consuming alerts from Slack)

● Understanding of the observability stack: logs, metrics, traces, and how they connect

● Experience navigating traces to identify performance bottlenecks or failure points in distributed systems

Scripting & Technical Automation

● Ability to write simple Python scripts for practical tasks: iterating over API endpoints, bulk retries, data extraction, automated reporting

● Comfortable reading and understanding code (Python, Go, JavaScript) even if not writing production-level software

● Experience working with REST and RPC APIs: understanding methods, status codes, request/response structure

Computer Science Fundamentals

● Solid understanding of how computers work: CPU, RAM (volatility, cache hierarchy L1/L2/L3), storage (SSD/HDD), and why these matter for debugging

● Understanding of network protocols: gRPC, WebSocket — and when each is used

● Understanding of microservices architecture vs. monolith: distributed system challenges (retries, exponential backoff, rate limiting, eventual consistency)

● Basic understanding of DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN (Cloudflare), VPN

Support & Communication

● 2+ years of experience in technical support or TechOps roles (FinTech experience preferred)

● Background in Forex or Crypto — either through trading or working with a broker

● English proficiency at C1 level — both written and spoken

● Experience working with CRM platforms

● Ability to determine when a problem needs escalation and to provide complete technical context when doing so

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.

O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um "clone digital" do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.

  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts

  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia
O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)
O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

Acesso a mentorias exclusivas e conteúdos avançados

Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade de horários

Contrato PJ com possibilidade real de crescimento acelerado

Nossa cultura

Aqui, valorizamos:

  • Alta performance com meritocracia verdadeira
  • Aprendizado contínuo e evolução constante
  • Ambiente colaborativo, leve e orientado a resultados
  • Pessoas que jogam para ganhar e crescem junto com a operação

Cada venda representa transformação real, para o cliente, para o expert e para a sua carreira.

Pronto para crescer no digital?

Se você tem mentalidade vencedora e quer se destacar em um dos mercados que mais crescem no mundo, essa é a sua oportunidade.

Candidate-se agora e venha fazer parte do nosso time de alta performance.

Chegou a hora de transformar conversas em resultados.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).

The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.

The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.

Financial

● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions

Operational

● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.

Experience and Skills

● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/Ai Tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/Ai Tools) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It's Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn't a place for coasting — it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We're looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You'll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they're not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You've shipped full-stack applications, you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‐edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you're not waiting for a PM to write a spec;
    you're in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don't let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it;
    you see an opportunity,you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Marketing Ai Agent Builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing Ai Agent Builder em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our\ "agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a\ "Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

- Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

- Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

- Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to\ "read\" prospect behavior andtrigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

- Performance & Guardrails: Establish\ "human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

- System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

- Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

- AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.G., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

- Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.G., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.Com) or code-based frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI).

- Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex\ "reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

- Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.

- Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.
